1.en: I used tomato paste to make the sauce.
1.zh: 我用番茄酱做了这道酱汁。

2.en: This portable charger fits in my pocket.
2.zh: 这个便携式充电器能放进口袋里。

13.en: You can acquire new skills by practising every day.
13.zh: 每天练习就能学会新技能。

19.en: The question may provoke a useful discussion.
19.zh: 这个问题可能会引发有益的讨论。

23.en: Her spontaneous smile made everyone feel welcome.
23.zh: 她自然流露的微笑让每个人都感到受欢迎。

25.en: Her story inspired me to learn to code.
25.zh: 她的故事激励我去学习编程。

30.en: Thirst made us stop for water.
30.zh: 我们渴得停下来找水喝。

33.en: The website will suspend your account after too many failed logins.
33.zh: 登录失败次数过多后，网站会暂停你的账户。

37.en: The doctor prescribed a cream for the rash.
37.zh: 医生为皮疹开了一种药膏。

42.en: Biotechnology can help farmers grow crops that resist disease.
42.zh: 生物技术能帮助农民种植抗病作物。

47.en: A simple mechanism locks the door when you leave.
47.zh: 你离开时，一个简单的机械装置会把门锁上。

50.en: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from the sun's radiation.
50.zh: 涂防晒霜，保护皮肤免受太阳辐射。

51.en: The new computer has better hardware.
51.zh: 这台新电脑的硬件更好。
